theme: A quiet Westhampton day winding down — lunch behind you, one job thread worth a careful eye.
greeting: Evening, Dan. The Hamptons day has mostly unwound: lunch at Flora is done and tomorrow's calendar is clear. One job-search email came in twice today and is worth a careful look before you close the laptop.

needsAttention.title: SVP, Global Public Policy — work-auth ask
needsAttention.detail: An "interview update" for the Senior Vice President, Global Public Policy role (REQ64085) arrived twice today from jobs@sourcehire.app, asking you to "confirm your work authorization" via a link to "keep your application moving." The role fits your background, but the unfamiliar sender, the confidential employer, and a visa-status ask by link are worth scrutinizing before you click anything.
